units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 5:1">Yoma V, 1</cite> <he>החיצונה היתה פ׳ וכ׳</he> the outer curtain was held back by a clasp on the north side, and the inner curtain on the south side (so as to make room for entering, without exposing to view the Holy of Holies).

senses.gloss: to fasten a garment over the shoulder by attaching a weight to its overhanging corner.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:7">Sabb. VI, 7</cite> <he>פּוֹרֶפֶת על האבן וכ׳</he> a woman may wear a cloak thrown over her shoulder weighted by a stone or a nut; <he>ובלבד שלא תִפְרוֹף וכ׳</he> provided she does not attach the weight for the first time on the Sabbath (v.

<cite ref="Shabbat 65b">Sabb. 65ᵇ</cite>); Tosef. ib. IV (V), 13 <he>פורפת בתחילה בדבר וכ׳</he> she may attach a weight for the first time using an object which it is permitted to handle on the Sabbath; a. e.—Part. pass. as ab.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 6:6">Sabb. VI, 6</cite> <he>ומדיות</he> (<he>יוצאות</he>) <he>פ׳</he> Median women may go out on the Sabbath with their cloaks thrown over their shoulders &c.
